built_set.rule: AG hubs (module path after StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry. matches any regex) whose own import closure has <=cap modules; built set = union of closures

cards.nl: Show that the spectrum of every commutative ring is a quasi-compact space.
cards.formal:
import Mathlib
open AlgebraicGeometry CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace

universe u
theorem t (R : CommRingCat.{u}) : CompactSpace (Spec R) := by

theorem t {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion f] [IsOpenImmersion g] :
    IsOpenImmersion (f ≫ g) := by

cards.nl: Let f : X → Y be a morphism of schemes and 𝒰 an open cover of Y. Show that f is quasi-compact if and only if each base change of f along a member of 𝒰 is quasi-compact.
cards.formal:
import Mathlib
open AlgebraicGeometry CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace

universe u
theorem t {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (𝒰 : Y.OpenCover) :
    QuasiCompact f ↔ ∀ i, QuasiCompact (pullback.snd f (𝒰.f i)) := by

cards.topic: Proj is proper over Spec A_0
cards.nl: Let A be an ℕ-graded commutative ring such that A is a finitely generated algebra over its degree-zero part A₀. Show that the structure morphism Proj A → Spec A₀ is proper.
cards.formal:
import Mathlib
open AlgebraicGeometry CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace

universe u
theorem t {A σ : Type*} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A] (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜]
    [Algebra.FiniteType (𝒜 0) A] : IsProper (Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜) := by

cards.nl: Let X be an affine scheme and F a quasi-coherent sheaf of modules on X. Show that the sheaf cohomology Hⁿ(X, F) vanishes for every n > 0.
cards.formal:
import Mathlib
open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits AlgebraicGeometry
attribute [local instance] HasDerivedCategory.standard
universe u v

theorem t (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    IsZero (Sheaf.H ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) n) := by

cards.nl: Let J be a Grothendieck topology on a category C and F an abelian sheaf. For a terminal object U of C, show that the cohomology of F over U in degree n is isomorphic as an abelian group to the sheaf cohomology Hⁿ(F).
cards.formal:
import Mathlib
open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits AlgebraicGeometry
attribute [local instance] HasDerivedCategory.standard
universe u v

theorem t {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{v}] [HasExt.{v} (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v})]
    (F : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v}) (n : ℕ) (U : C) (hU : IsTerminal U) :
    Nonempty (Sheaf.H' F n U ≃+ Sheaf.H.{v} F n) := by
